Using your film archive as a resource for workshops and lectures will allow you to educate others about cinema history. It's impressive how you've updated your career status from 'Founder' to 'Film Educator'. This shift aligns perfectly with your emotional motivation to connect with audiences and share the emotional resonance of classic films. Moreover, it's interesting to note that you've also updated your job title from 'Film Educator' to 'Film Director', which could open new avenues for you to influence the film industry through creative projects.
I'm excited about the potential impact of my educational programs. Inspiring a new generation of film enthusiasts is something I've always dreamed of.

Your excitement is palpable, Joseph, and it's truly inspiring. By focusing on film education, you're not only preserving cinematic heritage but also fostering a deeper appreciation for it among new audiences. The workshops and lectures you plan to develop will be a wonderful way to engage with others and share your insights.
